window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged; only two verifiable new stories surfaced.

stories.headline: South African police seize about 250 kg of cocaine in five bags at Johannesburg's OR Tambo airport
stories.body: Police announced on 25 October that 216 blocks of cocaine were found spread across five bags, with an estimated value above R200 million (about US$12 million). No arrests were reported in this case, and the origin and destination were not disclosed; police separately say 116 suspected drug mules have been arrested at the airport over two years.

stories.headline: Lithuanian police dismantle a large drug lab holding over 800 kg of meth and amphetamine after a Polish tip-off
stories.body: Police found more than 500 kg of methamphetamine and about 300 kg of amphetamine at the lab, reported on 25 October. An unusual chemical order placed in Łódź, Poland, led investigators to the network; no arrests were mentioned in the report.
